title: SG Data Pack v1.3 — Unified Data Contract for Component Libraries
description: The single entry point for business data of all sg-* component libraries. Globally unique entities, id references, stages that reference rather than duplicate. Runtime validation is performed by sg-data-loader.js (rules E1-E16/W1-W8 correspond one-to-one with the rules below); this file is the formal contract. v1.1 added: relations.scope, attributeTypes/attributeSources, contents, assets hash, meta.assetBase, kindNameFields. v1.2 added: sameAs (entity identity), provenance (record-level provenance as a parallel section that never invades entity bodies — zero engine changes), meta.confidenceThreshold, W6 fuzzy duplicate detection. v1.3 added: derivations contract (kind/source/consumers/note/alsoTouches/affects, E16-validated), E11 domain asset coverage, contextual alias {id,context} runtime resolution, E12 scope canonicalization, provenance W7/W8 warnings.

id.description: Library identifier, matching the directory name

hero.description: Core entity id (graph center / protagonist); must exist in entities

assetBase.description: Resolution prefix for bare-filename assets (e.g. '../assets/'); once declared, 'x.png' in the data resolves and registers as assetBase+'x.png'

recrawlFieldMap.description: (v1.3) Optional crawled-field -> entity-field mapping used by recrawl-skeleton for like-for-like cross-checks (e.g. {"birthDate":"birth"}). Without it, recrawl does not guess field correspondences.

kindNameFields.description: kind -> name-field mapping (e.g. {work: 'title'}); kinds not declared here default to the name field

sameAs.description: (v1.2) Entity-identity declarations: [[idA, idB], ...] means two entities refer to the same real-world subject (e.g. Ying Zheng ↔ Qin Shi Huang). Once declared, W6 no longer flags the pair; downstream dedup/aggregation relies on this.

provenance.description: (v1.2) Record-level provenance (parallel-section design: never embedded into entities/relations/contents bodies, so engines need no changes). Each group's keys point at the corresponding records; confidence below meta.confidenceThreshold triggers a W5 low-confidence warning.

entities.description: Global entity table. Keys are safe stable ids (semantic slugs); values preserve all business fields of the entity. Referencing by name or array index is forbidden. The formal schema requires kind; runtime E3 additionally requires the display field selected by kindNameFields[kind], defaulting to name, because that cross-field lookup is not expressed by this generic schema.

name.description: Default display field (may be Chinese; for display only, never a reference key). Runtime E3 requires this unless kindNameFields maps the entity kind to another non-empty string field.

kind.description: Entity kind: person / work / term / event / ...

aliases.description: Crawled name / variant spelling -> canonical id. The normalization entry point on the data-production side; resolvable at runtime via SGDataLoader.resolveId. Values may be a plain id string or a {id, context} object for same-name disambiguation (E9 reserved context).

relationTypes.description: Relationship-type registry (enum + display attributes). Every relations[].type must be registered here.

color.description: Color value or CSS variable reference

heroRelTypes.description: (optional, Plan-B dual registry) Relationship-type registry for the hero-radial dimension (person -> core). When overlay.rel / heroRel and relations[].type are semantically different dimensions, register them separately here and in relationTypes, with library-level rules forbidding cross-dimension use (e.g. qinshihuang: overlay.rel in {ruler, family, enemy})

relations.description: Master edge list; each edge is stored exactly once. Stages reference edges via {a,b} optionally disambiguated by id/type; duplication is forbidden. When multiple edges share the same (a,b) pair (relationship evolves across stages), scope, type, or a stable relation.id must make references resolvable.

id.description: (v1.3) Optional stable id for this master edge. When present, it is the preferred key for provenance and stage relation refs; duplicates are rejected (E12).

a.description: Entity id (or a crawled name from aliases, normalized during validation)

scope.description: (v1.1) This edge is only active in the listed stages (values are stages[].key). Without scope, the edge is active in all stages

stages.description: Stage/scene/event views. Carry only id references and stage-specific overlays; embedding entity fields is forbidden.

entities.description: Subset of entity ids for this stage

layout.description: Normalized coordinates keyed by entity id

id.description: (v1.3) Optional: resolve this ref to the master edge whose relation.id matches.

type.description: (v1.3) Optional: disambiguate by edge type when multiple edges share (a,b).

relations.description: {a,b} keys referencing master relations; type/label come from the master edge

overlay.description: Stage-specific information (persona/description overrides), keyed by entity id

attributeTypes.description: (v1.1) Attribute-label registry (symmetric to relationTypes). Labels in the attribute-pair collections declared by attributeSources must be registered here.

attributeSources.description: (v1.1) Path declarations of attribute-pair collections; supports 'entities.*.<field>' and 'domain.<path>'. Every [label, value, ...] pair or {label, ...} object in the declared collections has its label checked by E10

contents.description: (v1.1) Long-form content data layer: prose/timeline lifted out of template HTML. body is a restricted HTML subset; highlights declare in-text entity/annotation references (checked by E13 — a wrong entity name in prose is caught).

ref.description: Entity id / alias / domain.notes annotation key

domain.description: Library-specific data collections (works/questions/cast/notes, etc.), constrained by each library's own data.schema.json

assets.description: Asset manifest; keys are asset paths as they appear in the data

derivations.description: v1.3 派生契约：声明哪些呈现是从 pack 数据派生的、怎么派生、谁消费。文档化契约（非可执行代码），只建模非平凡派生（重复/排序/重建/消解/投影）。

kind.description: 派生类型：repeat=集合重复渲染；insertion-order=键插入序即呈现序；lookup-rebuild=按字段反查重建；scope-resolution=方向/作用域消解；projection=字段直投但有重组；reference-only=仅存引用运行时重建

source.description: 派生源的 pack 内路径（如 domain.carouselTrack.entityIds / contents / entities.*.name）

consumers.description: 消费方标识：引擎函数名或组件文件

affects.description: （可选）受影响的呈现区域/选择器

note.description: 人读说明：派生怎么工作、变更时的影响面

alsoTouches.description: （可选）次级影响源：除 source 外，变更这些路径也会影响此派生。用于 source 描述组合关系、但实体字段变更也影响呈现的情况（如 carouselTrack.source=domain.carouselTrack.entityIds，但 milestone.title 变更也影响渲染）。

origin.description: Data origin: engine-embedded-defaults / example-json-contract / template-html-contents / crawl:<source> etc.

sourceUrl.description: Original HTTP(S) source URL (mandatory for crawl pipelines); runtime E15 validates protocol and hostname

confidence.description: Confidence; baseline data (original case page) is 1.0, crawled data gets actual values from the pipeline

fieldOrigins.description: Optional field-level provenance for direct entity fields; keys are entity field names and values use the same provenance entry contract.
